name: Vouched Checkpoint
description: Know Your Agent platform from Vouched: detects AI agents on your site, enforces policy on them, and verifies agent identity and delegated authority with KYA-OS (MCP-I).

skills.name: Verify an Agent's Identity
skills.description: Verifies KYA-OS cryptographic proofs so your server knows which agent DID is calling and which delegation authorizes it.

skills.name: Detect AI Agents
skills.description: Detects AI agents visiting a site through a pixel, beacon, middleware or gateway, with a class, confidence and risk score.

skills.name: Enforce Agent Policy
skills.description: Evaluates each agent request against your policy and allows, blocks or redirects it before the request completes.

skills.name: Manage Agent Delegations
skills.description: Creates, verifies and revokes scoped delegations that let a user authorize an agent to act for them under set limits.
